Good to know.

How far in advance should I book?+
For colour or bridal work, two to three weeks ahead is ideal. Cuts and shorter treatments can often be booked within the week.
What's your cancellation policy?+
We ask for at least 24 hours' notice so we can offer the slot to someone else. Late cancellations may incur a small fee.
Do you do consultations before colour work?+
Yes, always — either a quick chat on the day or a separate appointment for bigger changes, so there are no surprises.
